1.label: very_easy
1.summary: Reach a resident through three floors with a one-canister budget and a ladder-bound fire cut; the other face offers the alternate passage.
1.natural_language: Reach the resident. Use the direction controls and spend a canister only if the passage you choose is blocked.

natural_language_by_interaction.simplified: Reach the resident. Use the direction buttons and spend a canister only if the passage you choose is blocked.
natural_language_by_interaction.full: Reach the resident. Use arrow keys and press Shift only when the passage you choose is blocked.

2.label: easy
2.summary: Reach a resident through four floors with a two-canister budget, one alternate ladder, one seam crossing and one off-route ember; ladder choices change the fire cost.
2.natural_language: Reach the resident. Plan across both faces, use the ladders, and choose which marked fires are worth a canister.

natural_language_by_interaction.simplified: Reach the resident. Use direction buttons and the eye to plan across both faces; spend canisters only on fires that open your route.
natural_language_by_interaction.full: Reach the resident. Use arrow keys and the eye to plan across both faces; press Shift only on fires that open your route.

3.label: medium
3.summary: Reach a resident through five floors with a three-canister budget, two ladder choices per landing, two seam crossings and two off-route embers; ladder choices change the fire cost.
3.natural_language: Reach the resident. Maintain both face maps, choose usable ladders, and keep the fire cost within your stock.

natural_language_by_interaction.simplified: Reach the resident. Use the direction buttons and eye to maintain both face maps, choose ladders, and keep the fire cost within your stock.
natural_language_by_interaction.full: Reach the resident. Use arrow keys and the eye to maintain both face maps, choose ladders, and keep the fire cost within your stock.

4.label: hard
4.summary: The baseline: a six-floor, nine-cell, two-face tower with a four-canister budget, alternate ladders, three seam crossings, three off-route embers and masonry clutter; route choices have different fire costs.
4.natural_language: Reach the resident. Use the eye to inspect both faces, cross seams deliberately, and choose a route whose fire cost fits the stock.

natural_language_by_interaction.simplified: Reach the resident. Use direction buttons and the eye to inspect both faces, cross seams deliberately, and choose a route whose fire cost fits the stock.
natural_language_by_interaction.full: Reach the resident. Use arrow keys and the eye to inspect both faces, cross seams deliberately, and use Shift only when opening a fire on your chosen route.

5.label: very_hard
5.summary: Reach a resident through seven floors and ten cells with a five-canister budget, three ladder choices per landing, four seam crossings, five decoys and dense masonry clutter; fire cost varies by route.
5.natural_language: Reach the resident. Keep a two-face route map, select ladders through seven floors, cross four seams, and keep the fire cost within the stock.

natural_language_by_interaction.simplified: Reach the resident. Use direction buttons and the eye to keep a two-face route map, select ladders through seven floors, and keep the fire cost within the stock.
natural_language_by_interaction.full: Reach the resident. Use arrow keys and the eye to keep a two-face route map, select ladders through seven floors, and keep the fire cost within the stock.

simplified.description: Direction buttons move or climb, a dedicated EXTINGUISH AHEAD button uses the current facing, and the eye button remains the alternate-face inspection control.

full.description: Arrow keys or WASD move and climb; Shift extinguishes in the current facing direction. The eye and certification buttons remain visible controls.
